title: Condo Retreat, Patio + Free Parking, by Vanderbilt
description:
This cozy, stylish condo is in a prime location for you to enjoy Nashville. Nestled in the Hillsboro Village area, you're walking distance to great shopping, coffee & restaurants of Hillsboro Village and 12 South. Close to Belmont University, Vanderbilt Hospital & University. Only 3 mi to Broadway Honky Tonks! Washer/Dryer, fully equipped kitchen, dedicated workspace, Smart TVs in both bedrooms & the living room + a large shared patio with a grill. Everything you'd need to unwind exploring!

The space
Attention Large Groups! We have additional condos for rent in this building. Let us know if you are in need of more space and we can send over options.

HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ 3 Beds - 2 King Beds, 1 Pull-out Couch
★ 2 Bedrooms
★  Full-size recently updated bathroom
★ Smart TVs in both bedrooms plus the living room
★ Custom wallpaper and interior design with a vibrant, welcoming vibe
★ WALK to Hillsboro Village, Belmont University, 12 South, Vanderbilt
★ Spacious shared lawn with a BBQ grill and outdoor seating.
★ Walk to restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and shopping
★ High-end fully-equipped kitchen 
★ Only 3 miles to Downtown Broadway Bars
★ High-speed internet
★ FREE Parking available in a lot connected to the building
★ Steps away from Kroger for any groceries you might need 
★ Free in-unit Washer/Dryer 
★ New finishes & furnishings meet original charm
★ Hair dryer, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and plenty of towels provided
★ High-speed WiFi
★ Keurig coffee machine + K-cups provided
★ Closets to store & hang your items in
★ Iron & ironing board 
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Full-length mirror
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: King Bed
Bedroom 2: King Bed
Living Room: Pull-Out Couch 

BATHROOM: 
Full size with a large standing shower off the kitchen space 

After a full day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this unique, modern, centrally-located condo. All aspects of your stay, from the welcoming colors & furnishings to the comprehensive supplies provided, were curated with ease + convenience for your vacation in mind. You will be centrally located with no need for a car at this location. Many things are within walking distance as we are located near some of Nashville's most desirable, rapidly growing areas - Belmont / Hillsboro Village / 12 South. The airport is only about 15 minutes away. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our home is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer!

Walk To (alphabetical order):

★ 615 Deli
★ Belmont University
★ Biscuit Love
★ Buttermilk Ranch
★ Bongo Java 
★ Dolly Parton's Recording Studio
★ Draper James
★ E3 Chophouse
★ Fannie Mae Dees Park
★ Fido Cafe
★ Five Daughters Bakery
★ Hopdoddy Burger Bar
★ Jeni's Ice Cream
★ Kroger Grocery Store
★ Photo Opps along 12th Ave. S. Murals
★ Proper bagel
★ Vanderbilt University + Hospital.

Guest access
You will have the entire home to yourself. We will send you your secure, keyless door code via the messaging inbox once your reservation is confirmed.

Other things to note
Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
